playbook_steps: The candidate's wallet history is ordinary (funded by an exchange).
All 8 of its peer connections sit in one attacker-controlled ASN (AS99999_BOTNET).
Those peers are freshly connected and report a chain tip 12 blocks behind.

Sybil.summary: Sybil Risk: 0.20. No significant Sybil clustering.
evidence: Funded by known exchange hub 0x435897ee...; funding-graph clustering not applicable.
Candidate account is newborn (0.0 days old).

indicators.description: Accounts funded by the same upstream entity within 5 minutes with identical amounts

indicators.name: Closed-Loop Transfer Ratio
indicators.description: Fraction of candidate transactions circulating exclusively among sibling cluster

indicators.name: Activity Similarity

indicators.name: Account Freshness

Wallet.summary: Wallet Risk: 0.04. Clean, unflagged transaction history.
evidence: Account has no abnormal transaction history.

indicators.name: Transaction History
indicators.description: Account has clean outgoing transaction record

Finney.summary: Finney Risk: 0.07. Clean transaction settlement record.
evidence: No conflicting mempool sightings or withheld block propagation anomalies.

indicators.name: Mempool Conflict Status
indicators.description: Presence of conflicting mempool transactions with different destination addresses

indicators.name: Hidden Block Withholding
indicators.description: Block containing self-transfer was withheld prior to merchant payment release

indicators.name: Propagation Delay Anomaly
indicators.description: Block delivery arrival lag relative to network propagation median

Eclipse.summary: Eclipse Risk: 0.92. CRITICAL Eclipse routing table monopolization detected!
evidence: Severe peer ASN concentration: HHI=1.00 across only 1 autonomous system(s).
Routing table takeover: 100% of peers sit in unverified ASN AS99999_BOTNET and 100% of connections are under 2 days old.
Critical backbone isolation: only 0.0% of peers connect to honest core.
NetworkX routing vulnerability: only 0 node-disjoint path(s) to honest backbone.
Coordinated peer churn: 8 of 8 connections established within the past 2 days.
Partitioned view: 100.0% of peers report stale block heights lagging consensus tip.

indicators.name: Peer Freshness
